ChatRoomMetadata.title: ChatRoomMetadata
ChatRoomMetadata.description: Metadata for a chat room stored in Firestore and synced with Supabase, visible to all signed-in members.

roomId.description: Unique identifier of the chat room document.

roomName.description: Display name of the chat room.

creatorId.description: UID of the authenticated user who created the chat room.

ambientThemeId.description: Optional ambient background theme identifier for the voice room (e.g., ROYAL_NIGHT, COFFEE_SHOP, RAINY_NIGHT).

MemberProfile.title: MemberProfile
MemberProfile.description: Public member account profile linked to Supabase and Firestore, including unique memberIdCode (رقم معرف لكل عضو) and RBAC role without exposing private email.

memberIdCode.description: Unique member identifier code (e.g., WNS-1042) shown across rooms, members directory, and Fadfada.

displayName.description: Member display name shown in rooms.

avatarUri.description: Custom avatar image URI or URL.

bio.description: Short personal bio or status message.

roomsCreatedCount.description: Total chat rooms created by this member.

roomsJoinedCount.description: Total room entries by this member.

messagesSentCount.description: Total chat messages or activity entries sent by this member.

supabaseSynced.description: Whether the member account is linked and synced with Supabase.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update.

UserRoleAssignment.title: UserRoleAssignment
UserRoleAssignment.description: Role-based access control (RBAC) assignment stored in /user_roles/{userId}. hamadanagy1979@gmail.com is the primary OWNER with full permissions.

userId.description: UID of the user assigned this RBAC role.

permissions.description: List of granular permission strings granted to this role.

assignedBy.description: UID or name of the Owner/Super Admin who assigned the role.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the role was assigned or updated.

MemberChatHistoryEntry.title: MemberChatHistoryEntry
MemberChatHistoryEntry.description: Personal chat history or room activity entry for a member.

entryId.description: Unique identifier of the chat history item.

userId.description: UID of the member who owns this history item.

roomName.description: Display name of the chat room.

activityType.description: Type of chat or room history event.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp of the chat history entry.

RoomActiveMember.title: RoomActiveMember
RoomActiveMember.description: Active member currently present inside a chat room.

userId.description: UID of the member inside the room.

roomId.description: Room ID that the member joined.

memberName.description: Display name of the member inside the room.

roleBadge.description: Badge of the member in the room.

supabaseLinked.description: Whether the member account is linked to Supabase.

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when the member entered the room.

VoiceRoomSeatDocument.title: VoiceRoomSeatDocument
VoiceRoomSeatDocument.description: Real-time voice seat state inside a chat room (/chat_rooms/{roomId}/seats/{seatId}) visible to all users.

seatId.description: Seat document ID (e.g., seat_0 to seat_7).

occupantUserId.description: UID of the seated member or empty string if vacant.

occupantMemberCode.description: Unique member ID code of the seated member (e.g., WNS-1042).

occupantName.description: Display name of the seated member.

occupantEmoji.description: Avatar emoji of the seated member.

isSpeaking.description: Whether the member is actively speaking.

isMuted.description: Whether the microphone on this seat is muted.

hasPendingMicRequest.description: Whether there is a pending mic request on this seat.

isSeatLocked.description: Whether the seat is locked by the room host/admin.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the seat state change.

RoomMicRequestDocument.title: RoomMicRequestDocument
RoomMicRequestDocument.description: Real-time mic request queue entry inside a chat room (/chat_rooms/{roomId}/mic_requests/{requestId}) synced for all participants.

userId.description: UID of the member requesting the mic.

memberIdCode.description: Unique member ID code of the requester.

queueNumber.description: Order number in the host's mic queue.

status.description: Server-side approval status of the mic request.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp when the request was submitted.

RoomChatMessageDocument.title: RoomChatMessageDocument
RoomChatMessageDocument.description: Live chat message inside a chat room (/chat_rooms/{roomId}/room_messages/{messageId}) synced across all connected devices.

senderMemberCode.description: Unique member ID code of the sender.

RoomPresenceBannerEvent.title: RoomPresenceBannerEvent
RoomPresenceBannerEvent.description: Transient room entry/exit event banner ('دخل العضو فلان' / 'خرج العضو فلان').

roomId.description: Room ID where the entry or exit occurred.

userId.description: UID of the member who entered or left.

eventType.description: JOIN when entering the room, LEAVE when exiting.

AnonymousFadfadaPost.title: AnonymousFadfadaPost
AnonymousFadfadaPost.description: Public anonymous venting ('فضفضة برقم معرف لكل عضو') post visible to all members with a unique memberIdCode instead of real name or email.

postId.description: Unique identifier of the venting post.

authorId.description: UID of the member who created the post.

memberIdCode.description: Unique member identifier code (e.g., WNS-4821) shown on the Fadfada post for each member.

moodTag.description: Mood or emotion tag chosen by the user.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp when the post was published.

FadfadaAdminIdentity.title: FadfadaAdminIdentity
FadfadaAdminIdentity.description: Admin-only identity record for an anonymous venting post containing the author's real display name, email, and memberIdCode, readable only by the app owner/admin.

postId.description: Matching ID of the venting post.

authorId.description: UID of the member who created the post.

authorName.description: Real display name of the member visible only to the app owner/admin.

authorEmail.description: Email address of the member visible only to the app owner/admin.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp when the identity record was stored.

PushNotificationEvent.title: PushNotificationEvent
PushNotificationEvent.description: Real-time push notification event triggered on a new chat message, friend room invitation, favorite room live broadcast, or mic request.

notificationId.description: Unique identifier of the push notification event.

senderId.description: UID of the member who sent the message or invitation.

recipientQuery.description: Target friend name, email, or 'ALL' for room broadcast.

roomName.description: Display name of the chat room.

VerifiedPaymentReceipt.title: VerifiedPaymentReceipt
VerifiedPaymentReceipt.description: Verified payment receipt required before unlocking VIP features or paid actions.

userId.description: UID of the member who completed the payment.

memberName.description: Display name of the paying member.

planTitle.description: Display title of the paid package.

transactionReference.description: Masked card last-4 or wallet/InstaPay reference number.

verified.description: True only after payment validation succeeds.

RoomGiftTransactionDocument.title: RoomGiftTransactionDocument
RoomGiftTransactionDocument.description: Document recording an interactive gift transaction sent between users inside a voice room or globally in Firestore.

transactionId.description: Unique identifier of the gift transaction.

roomId.description: Room ID where the gift was sent.

roomName.description: Display name of the room where the gift was sent.

giftId.description: Catalog ID of the gift (e.g., gift_rose, gift_crown).

costCoins.description: Total coins spent on this gift transaction.

quantity.description: Multiplier or combo quantity of the gift sent (e.g., 1, 5, 10, 99).

senderId.description: UID of the authenticated user who sent the gift.

senderMemberCode.description: Unique member ID code of the sender (e.g., WNS-1001).

recipientId.description: UID or identifier of the recipient user.

recipientName.description: Display name of the recipient user.

pkTeamSupported.description: Which PK team was boosted by this gift.

pkBonusPoints.description: PK battle points awarded by this gift transaction.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp of the gift transaction.

WebRtcSignalingDocument.title: WebRtcSignalingDocument
WebRtcSignalingDocument.description: WebRTC native peer-to-peer audio signaling document (SDP OFFER, SDP ANSWER, or ICE_CANDIDATE) exchanged via Firestore between active room members.

signalId.description: Unique identifier of the WebRTC signaling message.

roomId.description: ID of the voice chat room.

senderId.description: UID of the room member who generated this signal.

senderName.description: Display name of the sending room member.

targetUserId.description: UID of the target room member receiving the offer, answer, or ICE candidate.

sdp.description: SDP offer or answer string when signalType is OFFER or ANSWER.

sdpMid.description: ICE candidate media stream identification tag.

candidate.description: ICE candidate SDP string when signalType is ICE_CANDIDATE.

sessionEpochMs.description: Client session start epoch in milliseconds to prevent replaying stale signals when a new member joins.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp when the signaling message was written.

/chat_rooms/{roomId}.description: Collection storing chat room metadata documents shared with all signed-in members.

/members/{userId}.description: Public member profiles with unique memberIdCode linked with Supabase and Firestore.

/user_roles/{userId}.description: Role-based access control (RBAC) assignments where hamadanagy1979@gmail.com is OWNER.

/members/{userId}/chat_history/{entryId}.description: Member personal chat and room activity history.

/chat_rooms/{roomId}/active_members/{mem.description: Live list of members currently present inside a chat room.

/chat_rooms/{roomId}/seats/{seatId}.description: Live 8-seat voice stage inside a chat room synced across all devices.

/chat_rooms/{roomId}/mic_requests/{reque.description: Live mic request queue and server approval status inside a chat room.

/chat_rooms/{roomId}/room_messages/{mess.description: Live room chat messages synced across all participants.

/chat_rooms/{roomId}/presence_events/{ev.description: Live stream of join and leave notifications inside a chat room.

/fadfada_posts/{postId}.description: Anonymous venting posts ('فضفضة برقم معرف لكل عضو') showing unique memberIdCode without PII.

/fadfada_admin_identities/{postId}.description: Admin-only collection storing the real name, email, and memberIdCode of the venting author for the app owner.

/push_notifications/{notificationId}.description: Real-time push notifications for new messages, friend room invitations, mic requests, and live rooms.

/payment_receipts/{receiptId}.description: Verified payment receipts for VIP memberships and paid features.

/chat_rooms/{roomId}/room_gifts/{transac.description: Live interactive gift transactions sent between users inside a chat room.

/gift_transactions/{transactionId}.description: Global ledger of gift transactions between users across rooms and sessions.

/chat_rooms/{roomId}/webrtc_signals/{sig.description: Real-time WebRTC signaling channel (SDP Offer/Answer and ICE Candidates) connecting active room members.
